text:
Predicates:
HasVisa(x, y) ::: x has a visa y.
NeedsToApply(x, y, z) ::: x needs to apply for y if x wants to do z.
Student(x) ::: x is a student.
WantsToWork(x) ::: x wants to work.
Premises:
∀x (Student(x) ∧ HasVisa(x, F1)) ∨ HasVisa(x, J1) ::: International students in US have either an F1 visa or a J1 visa.
∀x ((Student(x) ∧ HasVisa(x, F1)) → NeedsToApply(x, CPT, work)) ::: An international student in US with an F1 visa needs to apply for CPT or OPT if the student wants to work in the US.
Student(mike) ::: Mike is an international student.
NeedsToApply(mike, CPT, work) ::: Mike needs to apply for CPT if he wants to work in the US.
Conclusion:
HasVisa(mike, F1) ::: Mike has an F1 visa.
